params._comment: Athena V6 Run A. Parameters are FROZEN at the values live Ares runs. No re-optimisation: this file measures what tp_momentum 0.18 and trailing_stop_pct 0.10 actually do. The six dead keys carried by V1-V5 (rsi_source, rsi_overbought, rsi_midline, rsi_extreme_low, macd_threshold, lookback_days) are removed — each shadowed a hardcoded literal, so tuning them did nothing.
params._divergence_comment: Run A. Divergence contributes to no entry, no exit and no rejection, matching what live Ares structurally does today: the pivot loop can never flag the latest bar, so all four divergence reads are always False in production. Run B would set this true with flags confirmed at i+5. Run B is optional, comes later, and must not be used to manufacture a nicer number.
